# Backpacker Advice

> > Comprehensive backpacking and budget travel guides covering destinations across Europe, Asia, South America, Oceania, and beyond with practical visa, budget, and adventure travel tips.

Backpacker Advice provides detailed destination guides for backpackers and budget travelers, featuring popular locations like Australia, New Zealand, Bali, Bangkok, Paris, and La Paz. The site covers essential travel information including visa requirements, budget planning, sustainable travel options, and adventure activities across all continents.
